title: FLA import: text-field filter in scene timeline desyncs binary parser — entire scene collapses to 1 layer
description: Reproduced with the golden-v2 fixture (fixtures/golden/golden-v2.fla + golden-v2.swf). golden-v2 is the SAME movie as golden.fla but with a Flash 8 filter (e.g. drop shadow) applied to the static title text field — golden-v2.swf differs from golden.swf by exactly one tag: a PlaceObject3 (filter) at depth 1, emitted right after the title DefineText/CsmTextSettings. IMPORT RESULT: golden.fla imports 4 scene layers; golden-v2.fla imports only 1 layer ('Layer 1') with a single text object, dropping the button, player instance, score, scripts, and frame labels. The library (Box/Coin/PlayButton) imports fine in both. ROOT CAUSE (diagnosed via swf-dump + instrumenting readCPicPage in packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts): the symbol timelines parse identically; only the SCENE CPicPage diverges (children=4 for golden, children=1 for v2). No warnOnce/bad-tag fires — the page-level CArchive child loop hits a PREMATURE null (0x0000) after layer 1, i.e. a silent byte-miscount while reading the filtered text object's CPicFrame. The parser doc comment (flash8-binary.ts ~line 41) states 'bitmap and text-field filters (skipped; only symbol-instance filters are decoded)' — that SKIP does not consume the exact filter-list byte count (SWF section 23 wire format), so the reader is left misaligned and the rest of the CPicObjBase children are lost. FIX: in the scene/text display-object read path, parse-or-skip the Flash 8 filter list with byte-exact length even when the filter is not mapped to a model type (mirror the symbol-instance filter decode that already works). Ideally also DECODE text-field filters into the model so they round-trip (task 0853 was marked done for 'text-field filters silently dropped' but does NOT prevent this desync — reopen/supersede). ACCEPTANCE: golden-v2.fla imports 4 scene layers matching golden.fla (verify: loadFla(golden-v2).scenes[0].timeline.layers.length === 4), and a golden-report-style diff of compiled golden-v2 vs golden-v2.swf shows the same tag inventory as the golden.fla case. Related done-but-incomplete: 0853, 0715, 1110, 1111.
